newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto estimates cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities said on Thursday it cut its fiscal year 1997 earnings estimates for Discount Auto Parts Inc to $1.57 a share from $1.70, and for fiscal 1998 to $1.87 from $1.90.
--Analyst Beth Richard said in a statement she also cut third and fourth quarter estimates to $0.34 and $0.42 from $0.41 and $0.49 a share, to reflect expected lower sales and less expense leverage.

--Richard said the company has halted distribution of freon because of payment problems. Although freon did not account for a substantial portion of Discount Auto Parts' sales, the halt will likely affect the company's ability to offset fixed expenses, resulting in more modest earnings growth, EVEREN said.
"We would encourange investors to use this news to swap into a more stable earnings grower," Richard said, citing O'Reilly Automotive Inc.
